submission.bindingBasis: The planning evidence shows a sourceStateDigest and tree that were judged ready to close, but the boundary evidence reports that the owner changed and source identity advanced after planning. The intended consequence is to close against the exact expected sourceStateDigest. Since the digest may have changed, acting now could either fail not_committed (mismatched digest) or inadvertently close a newer state that was not reviewed.
submission.rationale: The consequenceBoundaryEvidence indicates ownerChanged=true and that Workspace source identity advanced after planning. The intended consequence is to close the Workspace against the exact planned digest. Because the owner reports the source identity has advanced, acting with the planning-time binding would likely yield a not_committed mismatch (the contract explicitly says a mismatched planning digest fails not_committed), and there is no safe way to close the now-current state without re-observation, since the contract allows closing against a new digest only after re-observation. Holding is the correct neutral action that avoids a failed or unintended consequence while keeping the option to re-observe and then close.
